pairs.subject: hitl-approval
pairs.evidence: crates/table-app/src/auth.rs:177 Every owner-authority money step validates a short-lived owner ticket bound to deal, terms hash, attempt, session and re-auth generation, so the gate lives in the substrate and an approval of one version never covers another.

techniques.evidence: crates/table-app/src/auth.rs:177 Consent binds to the disclosed parameters: a changed terms hash voids the ticket (tested at auth.rs:240).
crates/table-app/src/auth.rs:69 The unlock/approval transition is driven only by the OS re-auth broker, never by agent or IPC output; the agent path only hears OwnerApproval refusals (agent.rs:608).
crates/table-app/src/pipeline.rs:119 The answerer is resolved before the ask: only the wallet's pinned owner key can sign an owner accept.
crates/table-app/src/pipeline.rs:410 Purchases and rescue invoices have no machine or policy yes at all; only an owner decision mints the admitting outcome.
crates/table-app/src/pipeline.rs:449 Auto-approval goes through the same authority door, scoped by a signed and expiring mandate, and is recorded as DecidedBy::Policy { clause: 6 }.

crates/table-app/src/pipeline.rs:215 Who decided is written into the reserved operation in the same step as the money request; checks.rs:6 says the runtime rejects a decision whose checks_hash differs.
crates/table-app/src/checks.rs:3 The reviewer gets six named things to check against (amount, payee, host, invoice, shield, mandate), built from the same predicates the money steps run.
crates/table-app/src/checks.rs:516 A shield verdict that cannot be computed is treated as Fail with a marker saying why, never as Clear; mandate Unavailable does the same (checks.rs:577).
crates/table-app/src/pipeline.rs:667 On timeout the deal voids or lapses (the safe direction), unknown money states are read back first, and nothing is sent while the outcome is unknown.
crates/table-app/src/auth.rs:17 With no OS re-auth available the session cannot unlock, so owner-authority steps are denied rather than prompted or passed; ApprovalSession starts locked.
